lessons_used: Preset customization fallback flow (+8.0%), interactive wait screen tips (+5.1%), story screen sequence reordering (+2.9%), and existing account retrieval sign-in hints (+6.0%) were helpful.
Most wait screen updates (progress bars, alerts, timers), sign-in step reordering, layout changes, and visual redesigns showed no clear effect.
Specific copy changes (-13.9%, -7.7%) and new desktop screens (-9.9%) significantly hurt performance.
Sign-in hints can be helpful (+6.0%), updating the previous trend where sign-in changes had no clear effect.

Predictions consistently overestimated positive impacts, but underestimated wins like story sequence reordering (predicted -1.0%, measured +2.9%) and account retrieval hints (predicted +1.0%, measured +6.0%).

lessons_next: Sign-in hints (+3.0% to +6.0%), preset customization fallback flows (+8.0%), interactive wait screen tips (+5.1%), and story screen sequence reordering (+2.9%) were helpful.
Most wait screen info updates and sign-in step reordering showed no clear effect.
Layout changes and new desktop screens showed no clear effect or significantly hurt performance (up to -9.9%).
Specific copy changes frequently hurt performance (up to -13.9%) or had no clear effect.
